# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
You will need to enter the records (fire-safety checks such as fire drills, regular checks of fire doors) one by one using this tool. All records are requested on a CSV basis, if you can get them in a better format please use whatever works for you.
3. If you can't get the records in the correct format (as in the instructions above), please advise support.
4. The CSV should take the following format (here it is with labels as column one):
    - Event - The date of the last inspection/check up until and including the date of the fire (in the format dd/mm/yyyy)
    - Inspection - The result of that inspection (in the format yes or no, 1 or 0, will return success or failed)
    - Detail - Any details on the inspection. Free form text.
